fusions.name: Silvered Darts
fusions.desc: Looses 3 darts of water at once, spread apart, each dealing 4 damage. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Netted Morsel
fusions.desc: Casts a net-bolt that deals 8 water damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 40% chance to leave it [Soaked] for 6 seconds, and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Glittering Cover
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, you move 20% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack. You restore 12 health when you cast it.

fusions.name: Slippery Wounds
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 40%, you regain 4 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds. You have 5% more dodge chance.
